profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google | Full-stack enjoyer | Tech Lead

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Mountain View, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Android Telemetry, Tech Lead (also TL-Manager for some time) (2021 - Present)

Core Debugging Tools, Tech Lead (2017 - 2021)

Search Infrastructure Tracing, IC (2015 - 2017)

Tech: Flume, Spanner, Bigtable, PubSub, Microservices, Server-side rendering, Anomaly detection, Angular, RxJS, Java, C++, Golang, Javascript, Typescript, HTML+CSS
positions.insights: Full-Stack Development, Software Design and +3 skills

positions.title: Graduate Research Fellow
positions.description: Conducted research in Human-Computer Interaction supported by a NASA Space Technology Research Fellowship (NSTRF). My research focused on supporting interaction with lightweight head-mounted displays, specifically as a tool to assist in remote collaboration with experts and as a component of a physical task guidance system.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Conducted research exploring the use of lightweight head-mounted displays, such as Google Glass, as classroom support tools in lecture settings.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Developed a system to allow telepresence robot operators to view 360 degree view of their surroundings. Designed and conducted a user study with the system, and the results were presented in "Can You See Me Now? How Field of View Affects Collaboration in Robotic Telepresence".

positions.title: Technical Intern
positions.description: Worked on multiple long-term (6+ months) IT projects for management users. Programmed mostly in C# on both front-end and back-end components.
